name: custodiet
description: Companion plugins for custodiet (Stop-hook accountability gates for Claude Code). custodiet itself is not a plugin yet: install it with `node scripts/custodiet-init.mjs --target <repo> --mode copy` (see README).

plugins.name: lanes
plugins.description: Splits gate notices, edited files and tool calls out of the transcript into their own lanes (subagents in a separate bucket): a one-line summary above the prompt, details in the /lanes pane.
